title: Back up move xdrip data to new phone
body:
Hello I just bought a new phone is there a trick to transfert the data to the new phone?  By data I mean history...  Not the app settings

Thanks

comments.body:
You need to press the 3 dots on the right side and do a backup.
Than load the backup on the new phone.
could you be a little more descriptive?  i dont see any options to actually backup!  all i see is export csv or export database
